messages.text: Hi, the running shoes I got are too small. Can I get a refund?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"Refund eligibility for shoes that are too small, return requirements, and applicable refund window"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/remaining", "title": "Each unit is refunded once", "text": "Each unit is refunded at most once, in full. A unit that was already refunded cannot be refunded again. A request for more units than are left is not paid; the assistant can offer the units that remain."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/amount", "title": "Refund amount", "text": "The refund for a unit is what was paid for that unit: its price minus its share of any discount. The shares are fixed once, when the order is recorded, and never recalculated: when a paid total is split among identical units, each unit gets the total divided by the number of units, rounded down to the smallest unit of the currency, and what is left over is added one smallest unit at a time to the last units, so no unit is refunded more than its price. Shipping charges are not part of the amount."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

tool_calls.name: propose_refund
tool_calls.arguments: {"order_id":"d06-o1","unit_ids":["d06-o1-u1"],"summary_for_staff":"Customer says the trail running shoes are too small."}

messages.text: I can’t refund the trail running shoes yet because our records don’t show that they’ve been received back. If you’ve already sent them, a staff member needs to check the return records (refund-policy/v1/return).
